name: Blank Location
description:
##  GET /api/v1/locations/create

Returns a blank object with default values
whenToUse: Fetch a blank location object with default values to prefill a new-location form before calling store_location.

queryParameters.name: index
queryParameters.description:
Replaces the default response index from data to a user specific string

ie.

```html
  ?index=new_index
```

response is wrapped

```json
  {
    'new_index' : [
      .....
    ]
  }
```
